answer: To join the haven, each identity files a timber chain-of-custody log: a harvest serial and a trellis-yard receipt, backed by a 70-credit bond and a 45-credit audit. An auditor checks timber serials against the haven's trellis register; a reused serial burns the bond, and a rented log fails because the serial binds to its filer. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 in audits plus 70,000 locked; an honest agent pays 45 once and reclaims it after a clean epoch.
